[LUNI.13.3.3] A `unit fx_pair` whose selector finds no matching live fact
converts at 1:1 — see [LUNI.4.6.1], which owns the rule and carries the
reasoning. This clause states no behaviour of its own, deliberately: a
restatement is a second copy to find and change when the rule moves, and one
of them not being found is the failure mode.
